title: Political turns and places to recognise
caption: Select a milestone. Era bands describe rule; buildings and institutions can outlast it. Dates and landmark associations: UNESCO's Qutb Shahi nomination, Karen Leonard's Hyderabad, and Wikipedia's History of Hyderabad and Hyderabad State.

events.title: Charminar / new city
events.description: Charminar marks Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah's new city. Golconda Fort and the Qutb Shahi Tombs belong to the same broader dynastic layer.

events.title: Mughal conquest
events.description: Aurangzeb conquered Golconda. A change of ruler did not erase the Qutb Shahi monuments.

events.title: Asaf Jahi emergence
events.description: Asaf Jah established autonomous provincial power while recognising formal Mughal suzerainty. Hyderabad became the dynasty's capital later, in 1763.

events.title: Osmania University
events.description: The university was founded during the last Nizam's reign; institutions as well as palaces belong to this historical layer.

events.title: Indian incorporation
events.description: Indian military intervention ended the Nizam's rule. Hyderabad State continued within India until the 1956 reorganisation.

events.title: State reorganised
events.description: Hyderabad city became Andhra Pradesh's capital; the former state's territories were divided, not simply renamed.

events.title: Telangana formed
events.description: Telangana was created on 2 June 2014 with Hyderabad as its capital.

events.title: Metro opens
events.description: Metro operations add a modern transport layer to a city whose older monuments remain visible.
